uncertainties.note: Rally/reaction lines from unnamed allied pilots and crew as the mission opens. No speaker tag exists in the table; identity is not asserted in the target text. Content (protecting Nirvash's path, urging Renton/Eureka onward) matches the Eureka Seven finale but is kept speaker-neutral.

Defection speech strongly implied to be the Izumo's captain (glossary character_names_021.json identifies Jurgens as 'Captain of the U.F. ship Izumo; later sides with Gekkostate'), following the Izumo's appearance in dialogue_10332-10336. The speaker is not named in the source rows themselves, so no name was inserted into the translation.

Speaker explicitly names Anemone as the person he wants to protect ('僕' pronoun, masculine self-reference), matching the glossary's Dominic profile ('Anemone's handler ... devoted to Anemone'). Identification rests on the explicit in-line name, not on inference; no name was added to the English text.
Reordered 'New Federation forces' Supreme Commander, Dewey Novak' into natural English name-then-title order across the \n break; meaning and both title/name are fully retained.

Rendered 新連邦軍 as lowercase 'New Federation forces' (military/personnel sense) rather than the glossary.json org entry's title-case 'New Federation' alone, matching existing corpus precedent (e.g. batch_01346: 'New Federation forces ahead!'). The bare organization name 'New Federation' remains reserved for the government/org itself per terms_028.json.

validation.fit: All rows drafted at full meaning, no display-based shortening; longest visible line stays well under the 110-character cap.
validation.controls: Every <op()>/<on()>/<sp(20)>/<ab(n)>/<ed()>/<off()> command copied in the same order as the source for each row; no color/book spans present in this range.
validation.terms: New Federation forces (glossary.json org.new_federation + terms_028.json 'glossary.json wins over the wiki form New UNE'), Scub Coral (researched, see glossary proposal), Coralian/Antibody Coralian/the Zone/Gekko/Gekkostate (mission_terms_019.json, meeting_terms_015.json), Nadesico/Nirvash/Renton/Eureka/Holland/Dewey Novak/Izumo (character_names_021.json, unit_names_014_b.json), Flail unit (corpus precedent, e.g. batch_04202.json), base (拠点, corpus precedent, e.g. batch_00993.json), Orange and self-propelled weapon(s) proposed in batch_10307_glossary_proposals.json.
validation.self_check: Ran an offline ASCII/length/j-q/smart-punctuation check against every row's visible text before submitting; see build notes in the final report.
validation.meaning_review: Independently meaning-reviewed: 80 of 80 rows examined against original ISO with 30 rows of surrounding context (10292-10401). No meaning fixes needed. All rows set to meaning_reviewed. See review_10307.json.
